ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to ACE sophomore, junior and seniors in Financial Planning concentration. Course seeks to introduce students to the intersection of the technical components of planning with the behavioral aspects of a relationship. Students will be introduced to concepts exploring how their own values system influence their skills as an advisor, basic skill sets in coaching and counseling clients, as well as experiential learning through mock planning sessions.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing. Restricted to BS: ACE: Finl Planning -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Agr & Consumer Economics department.
